name: legal-prospectus
description: A print-first (WeasyPrint) Canadian NI 41-101 preliminary-prospectus document template. Distinct register from the subscription-agreement family: austere Bay-Street filing typography, a running header, and the statutory red-herring notice — a regulatory convention, not a brand color.

variants.name: cover-page
variants.description: Red-herring notice, cover-title hierarchy (issuer = offering 14pt > doc-type 12pt > 10pt), 15pt price headline, offering table, price-to-public data table.

variants.name: toc
variants.description: All-caps entries, spaced dot-leader (CSS leader('. ')), right-aligned folio.

variants.name: prospectus-summary
variants.description: 28/72 two-column summary table, rule.emphasis page border, dilution-sensitivity (DHS) sub-tables.

variants.name: section1-preamble
variants.description: Header-free front matter — Eligibility for Investment, Forward-Looking Information, Non-IFRS Measures.

variants.name: body-section
variants.description: "PRELIMINARY PROSPECTUS" running header (GCPM running()/element()) + folio, hairline border beneath.

variants.name: financials
variants.description: Data table with subtotal (hairline) / total (accounting-total double rule) distinction, footnotes, sup/sub numerals.

aria: TOC entries are real anchor links with descriptive text (not "click here"); financial tables use <table><caption> plus <th scope>. The cover-page red-herring notice is a required statutory disclosure, not decorative — must remain in the accessibility tree.
motion: Print-first static document — no interaction states; renders to PDF via WeasyPrint.
open_questions: oq-1: red-herring #c00000 — confirmed brand-neutral/standalone regulatory token (BCSC/OSC convention), not a brand color; do not fold into any brand palette during future review.
oq-2: distribution shape — this family's production convention links CSS externally, differing from subscription-agreement's inline convention. Cross-cutting Paper question, not resolved here.

oq-3: NI 41-101 prescribes no type sizes — this family's 10pt/austere-heading register is a deliberate Bay-Street filing register choice, not a regulatory requirement. Do not cite the regulation as the reason for the type scale in any exemplar copy.
